three:
We should come home to ourselves with empty hands and only the gifts of ourselves to offer. To truly be anarchist is to employ the an extreme joy in disrupting  your notions of ownership and egoism. You as an individual have plenty, but you as a person don't hold the right to own it.

Anarchical love is to be free of our holdings and to live our lives with permission. Anarchism allows arbitrary lines to be crossed in order to constantly seek the consent and respect of others, and living a life with anarchism at its root allows one to live a life free of limitations that take from individual freedom.

three: You might go into this thinking that this is going to be a book about gaming, or about gamers and love in and around video games, but truly, it's a book about the many kinds of love that people encounter throughout their life and how these loves can overlap and interact. The book covers the naiveté of feeling you need to obsess over one outcome and should instead seek the joy of increments, as you watch your greatest goals become only stepping stones.
